description: This PHP file defines the class AM_ProjectTemplatesViewDetail, which extends ViewDetail, responsible for rendering the detailed view of a project template in the SuiteCRM module. It includes methods to generate HTML and JavaScript for user interface components related to project creation, such as dialogs and form elements.

classes.name: AM_ProjectTemplatesViewDetail
classes.description: A view class responsible for rendering the detailed view of a project template with embedded HTML and JavaScript for user interaction.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the display method to include custom HTML and JavaScript, rendering a dialog with form elements for project creation.
